title: Toward Automated Detection of Biased Social Signals from the Content of Clinical Conversations

bias_targets.methodology: Using Automated Speech Recognition (ASR) to transcribe clinical audio recordings and Natural Language Processing (NLP) models to predict socioemotional signals (e.g., warmth, attentiveness, dominance). The predicted social signals are then statistically compared between interactions involving white and non-white patients to detect implicit racial bias in provider communication.
